acceptance_predicates.description: Forward and rollback child operations have distinct durable identities bound to one parent session.
Target, operation, barrier, revision, and fencing identities cannot be substituted after admission.
Stale, competing, replayed, or ambiguous target identity rejects or enters durable recovery without mutation.

definition_of_done: Exact hostile tests cover forward/rollback identity collision, substitution, replay, and process-death recovery.
Independent review and hosted quality/formal checks pass for one exact product revision.
Public apply, rollback, release, and Dispatch remain rejection-only; the formal model remains best-effort guidance.

inputs.description: Completed AR-0088 forward barrier lifecycle evidence.
Existing durable forward and rollback child binding contracts.

outputs.description: A separately reviewable non-conflicting target identity contract and hostile evidence.

gates.description: All evidence identifies one product revision.
A separate review worker passes before merge.
No public mutation path is enabled by this AR.
